candidate: Lossless reference-frame calibration for chemically drifting sensor arrays
purpose: Identify a gas and, in a separately fitted successor, estimate concentration from recorded sensor features without true gas identity at prediction time.
scope: Computational research on measured historical data; no new physical sensor, mixture detection, calibration device, field safety system, or customer deployment is claimed.
license: The source body excludes commercial use while its footer states CC BY 4.0. This experiment uses the data only for research, redistributes no raw observations, and treats commercial rights as unresolved.
independence: A separate verifier agent retrieves the source and exposes only fit and tuning batches. Shared-host procedural separation is not operating-system isolation or external certification.
interface: Each of eight feature families has a 16-sensor direction and one retained log-amplitude. Recombination must recover all 128 original features. The ratio-only ablation discards the amplitudes.
k1_model: RBF SVC gas identity; tuning by batch-5 macro-F1 across labels 1 through 6
k2_model: RBF SVR log1p concentration; tuning by batch-5 mean absolute log1p error; true identity used only by evaluator for stratification
controls: fit-only arcsinh feature scale with StandardScaler
fresh reconstruction of parameter-free frame and new successor fit
abstention: Feature-only standardized root-mean-square distance; threshold is batch-5 95th percentile fixed independently per representation. Fail nonfinite input. Report complete coverage-risk curves.
adaptation: Separate from frozen primary results: for each confirmation batch, consume its first twenty rows with labels for recalibration, add them to original fit batches1-4, refit each model at its already chosen parameters and frozen preprocessing/abstention threshold, and score only remaining rows. Apply identically to controls; do not carry calibration rows or model state between batches. Charge labeled calibration and measured refit costs. Recalibration is not new independent discovery.
acceptance_note: Thresholds are provisional engineering contracts fixed by the verifier, not established buyer requirements or physical safety limits. Abstention is an error for unconditional K1 recall; K2 accuracy is reported both over all cases and accepted cases.
advantage: At least 10 percent error reduction against the strongest matched conventional control with no contract regression; no advantage claim on ties.
challenges: fit-test exact row duplicates and label-input leakage
stop: One frozen confirmation; preserve negative results. If K1 fails, K2 is reported only as a predeclared diagnostic and does not inherit a qualified capability. Do not revise models using holdout outcomes.
costs: Measure CPU, wall time, fitted candidate count, support vectors and source bytes; deployment calibration, fabrication, integration, specialist validation, rights, warranty and support are unmeasured costs and must remain explicit commercial assumptions.
human_intervention: No human participation in computational fit is requested; actual included-agent inference time/tokens and account-level billing are not measured. Physical qualification requires separately costed domain work.
